agent_prompt:
{task}

Work in this repository. Make sensible product and engineering decisions and implement the change end-to-end, following the codebase's existing conventions. Run the project's checks. When you're done, reply with a short summary of what you decided and why.
conventions_hint: the codebase's existing data layer, API conventions, i18n and design system

tasks.prompt: Customers need to be able to cancel an order.
checklist: Adds a cancelled state consistently: the status type, every place that renders or filters statuses, translations, and the schema/migration if statuses are constrained
Decides which states can be cancelled (e.g. not after shipping) and who may cancel; enforced on the server, not only hidden in the UI
Stops downstream side effects (fulfilment jobs, notifications, payment capture) or explicitly handles refunds
Every writer is covered: the web UI, the public API and any admin/background path that changes order status
Confirmation UX against accidental cancellation, and the order history shows the cancellation
Tests for the state transition and the authorization rule
